attchmntText: Gillette India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Gillette India Limited has informed the Exchange about the Press Release on the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.".
voiceSummary: Gillette India Limited announced unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, approved by the Board of Directors on November 13, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, sales were 846 crore rupees, up 4 percent year-on-year. Profit After Tax was 159 crore rupees, up 11 percent year-on-year. The company reported strong growth in its power Oral Care business, driven by the launch of Oral B iO2. Product introductions included Gillette Guard 3in1 and Gillette AIO Trimmer series. Profitability faced headwinds from commodity costs, which were mitigated by productivity programs. The announcement was filed with the BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited.

attchmntText: Gillette India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Gillette India Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board Meeting on November 13, 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, stood at 84,610 Lakhs, compared to 81,081 Lakhs in the corresponding period of 2025. Profit for the period was 15,910 Lakhs, up from 14,365 Lakhs in the previous year. Earnings per share were 48.83 for the quarter. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, revenue was 162,912 Lakhs, and profit was 31,855 Lakhs. The statutory auditors, Kalyaniwalla & Mistry LLP, issued a review report stating that the financial statements do not disclose any material misstatements.
